description: Refine typewell alignment with per-well GR normalization and multi-scale window correlation. EDA showed test GR mean=76.5 vs train GR mean=87.8 — scale mismatch hurts raw cross-correlation. Normalize lateral GR and typewell GR (z-score within well/typewell) before computing correlations, and compute alignment features at multiple window scales (21, 51, 101) to capture both fine and coarse geological structure.
implementation_notes: Z-score normalize lateral GR within each well (robust: subtract well-median, divide by well-MAD*1.4826). Z-score normalize typewell GR per typewell file the same way.
Use Pearson correlation (not raw correlate sum) of normalized windows — this is what makes correlation comparable across scales of GR.
Search range: lags in [-80, +80] in TVT units. For each scale (21, 51, 101), record best_lag and best_corr.
tw_xcorr_lag_agreement = std of the three best_lag estimates across scales — low std means high confidence.
tw_xcorr_lag_consensus_smooth_50 = rolling-mean(50) of the median best_lag across scales — smooth TVT estimate.
Use GroupKFold(5) by well_id. Target to beat: exp006 (36.394).
